name: Ulrich Senoner
bio: Ulrich Senoner is the soul of 'A Penny Weighs More Than a Soul'. Living at 2050m in the heart of the Dolomites (Malga Futra) without running water or electricity, he represents the ultimate spirit of resilience and connection with nature. His life is the subject of the upcoming documentary directed by Tobias Demetz, aiming for the Academy Awards.
